description:
Who we are  

 Lab37 Robotics , is a technology company focused on the development and deployment of robots designed specifically for direct-to-customer food production. Our mission is to revolutionize the food industry by creating innovative robotic solutions that enhance efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction. We are passionate about pushing the boundaries of technology to deliver cutting-edge products that meet the evolving needs of our clients.

  

 What you'll do 

 Take ownership of the developer platform experience that powers how software ships at Lab37. This includes improving CI runner performance and reliability, streamlining the PR landing path, and designing caching strategies that reduce build and test time across a growing monorepo and mixed-language stack.

 You’ll work with platform and release engineering teams to make builds faster, CI outcomes more predictable, and developer workflows easier to trust. This role is focused on infrastructure and execution quality around CI/CD under Cloud, especially during the transition as services continue to migrate into the cloud monorepo structure.

 Responsibilities 

 
 Design and implement caching strategies across build systems and package managers (for example, Turborepo and Bazel remote/local caching, dependency caching, compiler cache layers)

 Own Bazel build performance and reliability in CI, including remote cache strategy, cache hit-rate tuning, and build graph optimization

 Own the PR landing experience end-to-end: signal quality, required check ergonomics, merge confidence, and time-to-green optimization

 Own the workplace provisioning workflow 

 Improve CI runner infrastructure (sizing, placement, AMI/toolchain consistency, utilization) to reduce queue times and job duration variability

 Build CI observability and reporting for pipeline latency, and cost/performance trends

 Partner with teams to identify cost efficient opportunities to streamline the developer experience.

 Improve pre-commit and lint pipelines for speed and reliability without lowering enforcement quality

 
  

 What we're looking for 

 
 2+ years in Developer Experience, Build/Release Engineering, Platform Engineering, or CI/CD Infrastructure on AWS Cloud

 Strong hands-on experience with GitHub (or equivalent CI platform), self-hosted runners, and workflow orchestration patterns

 Proven track record reducing CI time and improving pipeline reliability at scale

 Deep understanding of caching across modern build systems (Turborepo/Bazel preferred), package ecosystems, and containerized CI

 Experience optimizing PR workflows: branch protections, required checks, merge strategies, and developer feedback loops

 Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, or similar) and infrastructure-as-code familiarity (Terraform preferred)

 Comfort working across polyglot stacks (web, backend, C++, embedded) and balancing shared platform needs

 Strong debugging instincts for non-deterministic CI issues (flaky tests, cache misses, environment drift)

 
 Desirable Skills 

 
 Experience with monorepo migrations and CI redesign during repository restructuring

 Familiarity with workload right-sizing across runner classes and cost/performance tuning

 Experience with Turborepo task graph optimization and remote caching

 Experience with Bazel remote execution/caching architecture in multi-language repos

 Experience building CI health dashboards and SLOs for engineering productivity

 Knowledge of security and compliance checks in CI (for example, secret scanning, policy gates) and performance tuning those checks

 Experience with practical patterns for AI-assisted development in CI/CD and DevEx workflows (for example, agent.md definition and infrastructure, build/debug assistance, and PR summarization)  

 
  

 Why join us 

 
 Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.

 Changing the restaurant industry: You’ll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery. 

 Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you’ll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer’s success.

 
  

 What else you need to know 

 This role is based in our Pittsburgh   office. As a company driven by invention and continuous change - we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

 The base salary range for this role is $130,000 - $164,500 per year. 

 Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.

 Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You may also be eligible for equity awards and an annual performance-based bonus.

 Benefits Summary (USA Full-Time Exempt Employees): 

 
 Medical, dental, and vision insurance (multiple plans, incl. HSA options).

 Company-paid life and disability insurance (short- and long-term).

 Voluntary insurance: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity.

 Optional supplemental life insurance for self, spouse, and children.

 Pet insurance discount.

 401(k).

 Health Savings Account (HSA)

 Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care, Commuter)

 Time Off policies:

 
 Discretionary vacation days

 8 paid holidays per year

 Paid sick time

 Paid Bereavement leave

 Paid Parental Leave

 
 
 Benefits are subject to change at the company's discretion.
Atoms accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

  

 Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?  

 #LI-Onsite
